a.lede: Huang, who was ousted as CEO following reports of an alleged affair with a woman suspected of spying for China, agreed to testify Wednesday after several senior lawmakers threatened to subpoena him.
a.title: Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress

b.lede: Three committee chairpersons want to grill Jensen Huang about his company's 'security protocols against foreign adversary espionage,' as a former CIA agent says that he had a target on his back as the leader of a trillion-dollar company.
b.title: Congress could issue subpoena to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang if he doesn’t respond by today to request for a ‘joint, closed-door briefing’
